mapper.select: SELECT rn, seq, id, title, content, regdate, refer, step, depth, readcount, delflag FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY refer DESC, step ASC) AS rn, seq, id, title, content, regdate, refer, step, depth, readcount, delflag FROM answerboard ) a WHERE ceil(rn/10) = #{pnum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answerboard VALUES(NULL,#{id},#{title},#{content},SYSDATE(), (SELECT nvl(MAX(refer),0)+1 FROM answerboard) ,0,0,0,'N')
mapper.update: update answerboard set readcount = readcount+1 where seq = #{seq}
UPDATE answerboard SET step = step+1 WHERE refer=(SELECT refer FROM answerboard WHERE seq=#{seq}) AND step > (SELECT step FROM answerboard WHERE seq=#{seq})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answerboard VALUES(NULL,#{id},#{title},#{content},SYSDATE(), (SELECT refer FROM answerboard WHERE seq=#{seq}), (SELECT step FROM answerboard WHERE seq=#{seq})+1, (SELECT depth FROM answerboard WHERE seq=#{seq})+1, 0, 'N')
